info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Legal Compliance Status API
info.description: The Legal Compliance Status API provides insights into the current compliance status of enterprise banking services. It serves as a critical tool for financial institutions to monitor and verify compliance with legal regulations. Typical consumers of this API include compliance officers, regulatory bodies, and risk management teams, who utilize it to ensure adherence to governance standards. Key operations involve retrieving the latest compliance information, enabling organizations to proactively address any potential compliance issues.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of legal compliance for enterprise services.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of legal compliance related to enterprise services. It provides valuable insights into compliance metrics and standards that must be adhered to within your organization.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to obtain the current status of the legal compliance services offered by the enterprise. It should be constructed carefully to ensure that all necessary parameters are included to get an accurate response.

GetLegalComplianceStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the legal compliance status operations under the enterprise services. It should contain a string value that corresponds to specific operational data or status.
